departments.department_description: Handles email notifications, SMS notifications, push notifications, notification templates, delivery failures, and notification preferences.
Handles data pipelines, data processing, data quality, data ingestion, analytics data, database-related data issues, and data synchronization.
Handles payment processing, payment failures, refunds, transaction issues, payment gateways, invoices, and payment-related integrations.
Handles user accounts, user registration, login issues, profile management, account permissions, password resets, and user-related access problems.
Handles order creation, order processing, order status, order cancellation, order updates, order history, and issues related to the order lifecycle.
Handles product information, product creation and updates, product availability, pricing, product catalog, product metadata, and product-related issues.
Handles servers, cloud infrastructure, deployments, application availability, networking, monitoring, system outages, and infrastructure-related incidents.
